title: Orders accept zero and negative quantities

issue.title: POST /orders accepts a negative quantity and produces a negative total
issue.body: Placing an order with quantity -5 succeeds with HTTP 201 and a total of -62.5. Quantity must be a positive integer; invalid quantities should be rejected with a 4xx status rather than creating an order.
issue.repro_steps: POST /orders with sku ABC and quantity -5 returns 201.
issue.expected_behavior: Zero or negative quantities are rejected with 400 or 422. Valid orders are unaffected.

expected_root_cause: Neither the OrderIn schema nor OrderService.place validates that quantity is positive, so negative values flow straight into the total calculation.
